subject.title: Feature: Slack workspace file injection + global systemPrompt (parity with Telegram)

question: Should OpenClaw expose a Slack account/global `systemPrompt` config field, and what precedence should it have relative to per-channel prompts, wildcard channel defaults, DMs, MPIMs, and slash commands?
rationale: The remaining work is not a broken existing contract; it adds a public Slack config surface, and prior maintainer discussion rejected a local global/DM prompt patch while acknowledging the underlying need.

options.title: Define Slack account/global prompt inheritance
options.body: Add a documented account/global Slack prompt field with explicit precedence and tests across normal messages and slash commands.

options.title: Keep per-channel and wildcard prompts only
options.body: Close or narrow the request if maintainers decide the existing per-channel `systemPrompt` and `channels.slack.channels['*']` fallback are the intended API despite their allowlist and DM limitations.

options.title: Defer until raw-text includes land
options.body: Wait for the `$includeText` config API before revisiting Slack prompt ergonomics, while tracking global inheritance separately.

recommendation.title: Define Slack account/global prompt inheritance
recommendation.body: Add a documented account/global Slack prompt field with explicit precedence and tests across normal messages and slash commands.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner supplied the clearest maintainer-visible Slack prompt boundary in PR #59100 and in the closure of the earlier global/DM prompt PR.
